text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Agnes Digital
flipping through an Umamusume magazine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh~~ this is so soothing...
When you're tired, there's nothing better than a dose of your fave~~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "...The truth is, I wanted to enter more races and see even more of the Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't believe my body won't keep up...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"No... Get up! Stand up, Digi-tan!!
If it's for the Umamusume, you can still keep going!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it!
Let your heart blaze for the sake of your fave~~~!"

It seems fatigue is piling up.
I may need to rethink her upcoming race schedule.
